hooks.name: Load project state at session start
hooks.description: Gives every new agent session the current branch, recent commits and uncommitted files, plus the project basics, so it doesn't start from stale assumptions.

action.command: echo 'Project: HiBeam (Kiroween 2026, Skeleton Crew). Foundation in Web/, apps in APP1/ and APP2/. Verify with: npm run check && npm test'; echo; echo "Branch: $(git branch --show-current)"; echo 'Recent commits:'; git log --oneline -5; echo 'Uncommitted:'; git status --short | head -20
